capabilities: Publish notes as posts or pages to Micro.blog
Upload local images and replace references with hosted URLs
Compose 300-character plain-text microposts from the desktop
Synchronize blog categories for tag suggestions
Update existing posts via a url saved in note properties
extras: The README states the plugin is community-maintained and not affiliated with Micro.blog; the micropost composer is desktop-only and limited to 300 plain-text characters.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish notes to Micro.blog, including uploading local images and updating already-published posts and pages.

relations.evidence: lets you publish notes to your Micro.blog blog — including posts, pages, and quick microposts

summary: Publishing plugin that sends Obsidian notes to a Micro.blog blog as posts, pages, or short microposts, with image upload and update support.
